result.topic_en: Riemann's integration method for a linear hyperbolic equation: Green-type transformation of a double integral into a boundary integral, an adjoint equation for v, and the boundary conditions that make the boundary integral give w at an arbitrary point (p',q').

methods.what: Green-type integration by parts turning the area integral into an area integral of w times the adjoint operator applied to v plus a boundary integral
methods.quote: $\iint w\left(\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial p\partial q}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right)\partial p\,\partial q+\int v\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}+w\right)dp+w\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial q}+v\right)dq=0$

methods.quote: (2) $\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial p\partial q}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial v}{\partial q}=0$

methods.quote:

für sich gleich Null.
